description: This file defines a custom Smarty class extension for the vtiger CRM application. It sets cache directories, assigns template variables, and includes a method for caching tag cloud display information per user.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A subclass of Smarty that adds vtiger-specific configuration, variable assignment, and tag cloud caching logic.

methods.name: lookupTagCloudView
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the tag cloud view for a specific user ID.

methods.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
methods.description: Constructor that sets up Smarty directories and assigns several template variables related to user and display settings.
